name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-narrated-story-animation
title: Narrated Story Animation
shortDescription: Creates a self-contained cinematic HTML story animation for a customer story, launch, campaign, or tutorial, with Story Studio scenes, captions, and narration.
longDescription: Turns a brief or SharePoint source into a 6–9 scene narrated HTML story using the Story Studio editorial system: title, stats, bars, route, network, timeline, quote, result, and CTA.

Outputs one offline file with wipe transitions, count-ups, captions synced to browser speech, a voice picker, and playback controls. Fictional names and figures are labelled when no source is supplied.
Save the finished HTML to the site Reports library.
